description: This file defines the ViewQuickedit class, a PHP class responsible for handling AJAX-based quick edit functionality within the SuiteCRM module. It manages rendering the quick edit interface, loading view definitions dynamically, and integrates with the application's MVC framework, including security checks, template setup, and handling subpanels.

classes.name: ViewQuickedit
classes.description: A PHP class extending ViewAjax that manages the quick edit AJAX interface, including rendering edit forms, handling different view templates, and integrating with the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the environment before display, including loading the related bean based on request parameters and setting the form mode flag.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles rendering the quick edit form, including loading view definitions, security checks, choosing templates, and outputting the form HTML or redirect scripts.

methods.name: getEditView
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the EditView class used for rendering the form.
